notes.title: 14 July Update - New Gems!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40426326/9f53de78aafbf5cb4c38eea7c16a9cb62fee5b2a.gif
Main Changes:
[olist]
 The gems on the board are new and different from one another.
 Gem Frenzy intro animation added; inspired by Dreamcast-era games.
 First game check - turns off research and mining for your first game (if you want).
 Major notification panel - UI animation when major things happen, i.e. a tower is destroyed.
 Next closest gem info - In Gem Frenzy, your Lazarr Gun now shows the gem closest to completion.
[/olist]

notes.title: Cascade Buffs
notes.content:
Main Changes:
[olist]
Cascade Buffs - When executing a cascade/combo (one match falls into another), the spawned minions become 'linked' and buffed.  The link can be shot to debuff the minions.
No More Starcraft - Starcraft/Warcraft sfx have been removed and replaced with less illegal sfx.
Steam Stats - The stats page is in the process of being converted to Steam stats.  This is the first version of that.
Environmental work - Fireflies, cause why not?
Gem Frenzy Update - Mining and research are turned off during GF mode.  Don't need 'em here.
Credits page - So you can see in-game that I made this videogame.  Rough draft.
[/olist]

Mac Update
[olist]
Zoom + shooting - fixed issue where you couldn't shoot while zoomed.  Sorry bout that.
General update - this is the first update for Mac since Novemeber.  There are probably Gem Frenzy updates and more!
[/olist]
